PROBLEM_TYPES_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Problem types operators assign to conversations, grouped by main label. Operators add new types right from a conversation; here you can rename, merge duplicates and delete unused ones.
PROBLEM_TYPES_SETTINGS.EMPTY: No problem types yet. Operators create them from the conversation sidebar.

RENAME.ERROR: Could not rename the problem type

DELETE.TITLE: Delete «{name}»?
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: The type is not used in any conversation, so nothing else will change.
DELETE.ERROR: Could not delete the problem type

MERGE.TITLE: Merge «{name}» into another type
MERGE.DESCRIPTION: {count} conversation(s) will move to the selected type, and «{name}» will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
MERGE.NO_TARGETS: This label has no other types to merge into.
